slides.title: Designing calm software
slides.subtitle: Fewer choices, clearer defaults, better outcomes
slides.narration: This is a short brief on designing calm software: products with fewer choices, clearer defaults, and better outcomes.
We will cover why clutter costs us, the pipeline we use, the principles in practice, a comparison, and what we ship next.

slides.label: of trial users never finish setup
slides.context: Illustrative example data. Every extra step in onboarding is a place where people quietly give up.
slides.narration: In this illustrative example, seventy-three percent of trial users never finish setup. Every extra step is a place where people quietly give up.

slides.title: The calm pipeline
slides.caption: Each stage has one job and one output.
slides.narration: Our pipeline has four stages. Capture the raw material. Structure it into an outline and a script. Render motion and audio. And ship every format at once.

slides.title: Three rules we design by

cards.title: One primary action
cards.text: Every screen has a single obvious next step.
cards.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="24" cy="24" r="18"/><circle cx="24" cy="24" r="6"/></svg>

cards.title: Defaults that decide
cards.text: Smart defaults replace settings nobody reads.
cards.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 14h32M8 24h20M8 34h26"/><circle cx="36" cy="24" r="4"/></svg>

cards.title: Quiet feedback
cards.text: Confirm with motion, not with modal dialogs.
cards.icon: <svg viewBox="0 0 48 48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 25l9 9 19-20"/></svg>

slides.narration: We design by three rules. One primary action per screen. Defaults that make the decision for you. And quiet feedback, using motion instead of modal dialogs.

slides.title: Less on screen, more in focus
bullets: Group by task, not by feature
Use one accent color for the next step
slides.narration: In practice, that means grouping by task instead of by feature, hiding advanced options until they are needed, and reserving the single accent color for the next step.

slides.title: Legacy versus calm
slides.narration: Side by side, the calm version cuts setup from twelve steps to three, replaces most settings with defaults, and keeps what already worked.

slides.text: The best interface is the one you stop noticing after the first minute.
slides.author: Design team principle
slides.narration: As our handbook puts it: the best interface is the one you stop noticing after the first minute.

slides.title: One source of truth
bullets: Slides, script and video stay in sync
slides.narration: Everything ships from one source of truth. Slides, script and video stay in sync, you edit once and re-render, and the PowerPoint stays editable for final polish.

slides.title: Build calmer products
slides.subtitle: Questions and feedback welcome
slides.narration: Thank you. Let's build calmer products.
